bid--verb.def: To offer a price at an auction or for a contract.
bid--verb.ex: Three firms bid for the work.
bid--verb.exTr: İş için üç firma teklif verdi.

constant--adj.def: Happening all the time, or staying the same.
constant--adj.ex: The engine makes a constant hum.

medication--noun.def: Medicine used to treat an illness.

employee--noun.def: A person who is paid to work for a company.

solar--adj.def: Relating to the sun or using its energy.

phase--noun.def: One stage in a process of change.
phase--noun.ex: The first phase ends in May.

prom--noun.def: A formal dance for students in an American school.
prom--noun.ex: She bought a dress for the prom.
prom--noun.exTr: Mezuniyet balosu için bir elbise aldı.

fleet--noun.def: A group of ships or vehicles owned together.
fleet--noun.ex: The company runs a fleet of vans.

lame--adj.def: Unable to walk properly, or weak and unconvincing.

whip--verb.def: To hit with a whip, or to beat cream quickly.

smash--verb.def: To break something violently into pieces.

nut--noun.def: A hard-shelled fruit, or a metal piece used with a bolt.
nut--noun.ex: Tighten the nut with a spanner.

executive--adj.def: Relating to managing a company or governing.

executive--noun.def: A senior manager in a business.

gently--adv.def: In a soft and careful way.

petty--adj.def: Small and not important, or unkind about small things.

massage--noun.def: The rubbing of the body to relax the muscles.
massage--noun.ex: A massage eased his back pain.

audition--noun.def: A short performance to test an actor or a singer.

interfere--verb.def: To involve yourself in something that is not your business.
interfere--verb.ex: Do not interfere in their argument.

conduct--verb.def: To carry out an activity, or to lead an orchestra.

reverse--verb.def: To change a decision to the opposite, or to drive backwards.

investment--noun.def: Money put into something to gain more later.
investment--noun.ex: The road was a good investment.

absurd--adj.def: So unreasonable that it seems silly.

tag--noun.def: A small label attached to something.

ash--noun.def: The grey powder left after something burns.

parade--noun.def: A public procession to celebrate something.

pearl--noun.def: A small white jewel that grows inside an oyster.

priority--noun.def: Something that must be dealt with first.

cherry--noun.def: A small round red fruit with a stone inside.
cherry--noun.ex: The cherry trees are in flower.

unconscious--adj.def: Not awake and not aware of what is happening.
unconscious--adj.ex: He lay unconscious for an hour.

specifically--adv.def: For one particular purpose or in an exact way.
specifically--adv.ex: The tool was made specifically for this.

candidate--noun.def: A person who applies for a job or stands in an election.

lance--noun.def: A long pointed weapon used by riders in the past.
lance--noun.ex: The knight carried a long lance.

explode--verb.def: To burst suddenly with great force.
explode--verb.ex: The old boiler exploded at night.

vital--adj.def: Absolutely necessary for success or life.
vital--adj.ex: Water is vital for the crop.

retreat--noun.def: A move back from danger, or a quiet place to rest.

retreat--verb.def: To move back, especially from an enemy.

alliance--noun.def: An agreement between countries or groups to help each other.
alliance--noun.ex: The two parties formed an alliance.

clothing--noun.ex: Bring warm clothing for the hills.

wreck--noun.def: A destroyed ship, car or building.

stab--verb.def: To push a knife into someone.
stab--verb.ex: The victim was stabbed in the arm.

inch--verb.def: To move very slowly and by small amounts.

scandal--noun.def: An event that shocks people and damages reputations.
scandal--noun.ex: The scandal forced him to resign.

stink--verb.def: To have a very unpleasant smell.
stink--verb.ex: The bin stinks in this heat.
stink--verb.exTr: Bu sıcakta çöp kutusu pis kokuyor.

shield--noun.def: A flat object carried to protect the body.

rehearsal--noun.def: A practice session before a performance.

scan--verb.def: To look over something quickly, or to make a digital copy.
scan--verb.ex: She scanned the page for a name.
scan--verb.exTr: Bir isim için sayfaya göz gezdirdi.

dignity--noun.def: Calm serious behaviour that earns respect.
dignity--noun.ex: He accepted the loss with dignity.

lean--verb.def: To bend from an upright position, or to rest against something.
lean--verb.ex: Do not lean on the glass.

gossip--verb.def: To talk about other people's private lives.

humble--adj.def: Not proud, or simple and poor.
humble--adj.ex: He came from a humble family.

threaten--verb.def: To say you will harm someone, or to put something at risk.

foul--adj.def: Very unpleasant in smell, taste or behaviour.
foul--adj.ex: A foul smell came from the drain.

coma--noun.def: A deep unconscious state caused by illness or injury.
coma--noun.ex: She was in a coma for a week.

oath--noun.def: A formal promise, often made in court.

deposit--verb.def: To put money in a bank, or to leave something somewhere.
deposit--verb.ex: He deposited the cash on Friday.

relieved--adj.def: Happy because a worry has ended.
relieved--adj.ex: We were relieved to hear the news.

solo--adv.ex: He sailed solo across the bay.

solo--noun.def: A piece of music performed by one person.

personnel--noun.def: The people who work for an organization.

beam--noun.def: A line of light, or a long piece of wood holding a roof.
beam--noun.ex: A beam of light crossed the wall.

operator--noun.def: A person who works a machine or connects phone calls.

remaining--adj.def: Still left after the rest has gone.

acid--noun.def: A chemical that can burn and has a sour taste.

anonymous--adj.def: With a name that is not known or not given.

brother-in-law--noun.def: The brother of your wife or husband.
brother-in-law--noun.ex: My brother in law runs a bakery.

roommate--noun.def: A person you share a room or a flat with.

protest--verb.def: To say or show publicly that you disagree.

embrace--noun.def: The act of holding someone closely in your arms.
embrace--noun.ex: They met in a long embrace.

flame--noun.def: The bright burning part of a fire.
flame--noun.ex: A small flame lit the room.

cemetery--noun.def: A place where dead people are buried.
cemetery--noun.ex: The cemetery lies behind the mosque.

gum--noun.def: The firm flesh around your teeth, or chewing gum.

content--adj.def: Happy and satisfied with what you have.
content--adj.ex: She seems content with the result.

corporal--adj.ex: Corporal punishment is banned in schools.

ton--noun.def: A unit of weight equal to a thousand kilos.

keen--adj.def: Very interested and eager to do something.
keen--adj.ex: He is keen to start work.
